releaseNotes:
PRVN Music v0.16.2 (Build 22):
- Completely removed all third-party promotional popups and upstream attribution prompts.
- Refreshed branding to Developed by Pritam (https://github.com/pritam-79/PRVN-Music) across all 30 languages.
- Listen Together Room Permissions: Host Only, Everyone Can Control, Approved Members.
- Fixed playback synchronization glitch on track transition and eliminated 0:00 restart bug.
- Universal Cloud Sync: Real-time cross-platform synchronization with active device arbitration.
- Official PRVN Music for iPhone v0.01 release.
